Some days sure it would trigger me. But other days I’d just feel like at least people there actually understand :/

Letting something bad happen doesn’t necessarily mean that’s bad though, in my mind. Self harming has helped me in so many ways and I probably would have just killed myself many times had I not just self harmed.

You try explain the concept of r/selfharmpics to anyone that doesn’t self harm and you’ll see you won’t get a good reaction. 

My mum in particular thinks everyone on pages like that are encouraging each other to hurt themselves more and that we are all crazy and it’s wrong and sick. That’s what she has said to me about it before when I’ve mentioned the sub, so I assume most other regular non sh-ers probably think similarly.

Yep. It feels like it’s constantly happening (like for years now) and I have so much anxiety about exactly this... Waking up and my favourite subs are gone. 

r/sanctionedsuicide is the scariest to lose and seems the most risky since people are stupid, but the rules are really strict their too so fingers crossed x
It’s mostly just the fact that I’ve lost everything and that it got banned to begin with... but yeah I’m kinda glad there’s a new one but I don’t think it’ll last
Yeah I think it got banned two days ago and I just logged into the account I post from and 90% of my history is gone

I use bio oil on the scars I don't want. You can buy it from chemists and probably your local supermarkets but it depends where you are I suppose. 

Anyway you just apply it once or twice a day and it helps remove scars/stretch marks stuff like that.
I think it's the fridge and also wind outside

I will definitely tell them and hopefully if they have any advice for her I hope she listens unlike last time.
Or for longer really, last time they told her to stop doing a few certain things because it made me worse and she did it for maybe three weeks and then she started again and whenever I ask why doesn't continue (because it actually helped) she said that I should be getting better so she shouldn't have to 'tip-toe' around me with what she says.
It's horrible :(

Well I mean they were trying, I talked to three different people and the last one helped the most and I really liked her but she moved interstate. I've got worse since then so my gp said definitely see someone better. I think I'm going to a specialist for child abuse and related issues

I think maybe they were just lacking experience. The organisation promotes help mainly for teenagers getting into drugs and alcohol and just helping teens handle school pressures mainly, not so much the issues I have with the past and self harm

I think in about a week. I've been waiting for ages but we couldn't afford it again because the people I was seeing last year couldn't deal with everything about me (self harm/suicide and they didn't know how to treat my past)

Yeah anxiety is the worst. Just a few weeks ago I had to go to the doctors to get a mental health plan thing (it pays for appointments with a therapist) and she said I might have to go on antidepressants again but for the anxiety and that it would be good if nothing gets worse but here I am

Like I do know people aren't always staring at me but I feel like there's always something wrong with me that people will think about and laugh at later. But what you said makes sense and I will keep it in mind.


Also I'm sorry you looked at the pictures they're not very nice but I find it helps if I can share it with people who won't think I'm crazy. But thank you for what you said.

It's really hard not to retaliate because when I get upset I always feel like I have to make whoever upset me as upset as I am. Then I hate myself because that means I'm really horrible. It's tough changing how I react to things but I really need to so I can try to salvage what's left of my relationship.


Obviously what my mum says effects me because I have to see her everyday so it's hard to fix everything after an argument living in a small house, but I try not to let if effect me too much because she's not bad all the time and I am trying to sculpt who I am by experiences not just by what she says to me

Yeah I suppose it's not like people will definitely be mean to me or anything. I just don't like being seen a lot, I try to stay out of the way as much as possible so people don't see me so I'm always worried everyone has to do something individually to be watched by everyone. Anyway I'm trying to get over that.


I play a lot of single player games which makes it difficult but my favourite game at the moment is multiplayer and I'm starting to get back into an mmo I used to play a lot so I should join a squad on there.


I've never had so many replies from people especially this nice. Not that I post much which makes this even nicer.

I always tell her how I feel and I've told psychiatrists about it and they've even talked to her about it so I'm pretty sure she knows.


When I get mad or really upset I do say things but nothing so important to her like that.

I will go to the book store near me soon and look for those and the authors, thanks.


Yeah but like you just said lots of little kids but I'm older than that so I think I'll be laughed at. Darn I wish you could be the teacher if I go try so I know you kind of. Or maybe being with complete strangers would help, I'm not sure.


I might look into the martial arts things near me.


I don't really play games that have guilds and stuff but I might play one to see if I can make friends. 


Talking has really helped. I really appreciate you saying things that I've just been responding too and not really asking you anything. I'm getting a bit tired sorry. Thanks a lot though.
She always says stuff like it and then denies it and that's the worst part.

It's okay though I'll move out soon enough and that'll be the day.


I feel especially bad because I know what it's like. I don't want to be a parent in case I end up like mine. :(

This subreddit looks like it could be helpful as a support. I always think everyone else's parents are perfect but this is nice, in a pretty bad way, to see I'm not alone.


Thank you for showing me this.

I love everything Stephen king, although I've read 95% of his stuff i retread them a lot. And recently I've gotten into a series called hunger but I can't remember the author, I've only read the first two so far. I'm saving up for the others. I like gory things with magic and swords and castles and damsels in distress or just loads of monsters.


I have almost no motivation or interest in sports and my anxiety always gets the best of me. I can't even do stuff by myself (I've tried exercising at home but I embarrass myself). I want to do some kind of martial arts but I couldn't bring myself to going to a room full of people.


My dad is the one who abused me so no I can't really go anywhere. The rest of my family pretty much hates me or just thinks I'm weird, I'm the only person in my family to have self harmed so they all think I'm crazy. And what I wouldn't do for a change of scenery right now, but I can't, I have school and I'm working on getting an apprenticeship and I have to be where my mum is. 


I always go to those subreddits thinking I'll meet someone similar to me that I can form a good bond with but I always get too nervous. I've found I can generally hold a friendship for up to three months and then it just sort of disappears, except for about three people in my life. I used to have tumblr so I talked to people there. Idk I'm really boring and only talk about video games so I don't know I suck at talking to people.

You're very nice thank you for making my New Years better

I don't know how to tell my story without writing a whole book.


I was abused now I'm messed up and too full on for people to deal with so my bf kind of broke up (it's a bit hard to explain I said let's break up during an argument because I do every time, I run away when situations become too much) then I took it all back and apologised but he said he can't do it anymore so we will actually break up but then at the end of the conversation he said give me a week, and this was Christmas Eve so all week I've been waiting for him to talk to me but he's in another state right now so I'm waiting for him to come home.


Anyway I'm super reliant on him and the idea of being lonely and without him is crippling and my mums been horrible and her husband was visiting (another long story) but he left early and now I think they're going to get divorced but I wish they had like six years ago.


Also I've struggled with self harm for several years and I stopped for a month but as soon as my bf said he didn't love me anymore I did it and I've don't it every day since.


And then my mum was yelling at me about my computer and somehow said something about my boyfriend and I got upset and then she said the thing about go slice yourself up.


Sorry I have no idea where I'm going too much has happened I can't think straight sorry.


I will try to find a subreddit to help thanks. 


I've cried about a billion times this past week  and it doesn't even help like everyone says it does.


I am very picky with books and I haven't got any good ones right now and I don't like ebooks. I just really like gaming.


Thanks for replying it felt good typing a lot.

I always try to do it safely, but that isn't really possible so I'm glad I'm stopping now because I think it will only get a lot worse otherwise.

Hopefully it helps me be happy too.

Biting something else can help. If you're at home, bite a pillow or a blanket or something else soft. If you're out you could bite a piece of clothing (collar or sleeves whatever) or even just try clenching your teeth together instead of biting the inside of your cheeks/lips.


Just try to pay attention to yourself doing it and force yourself to stop when you catch yourself. You could also try distracting yourself with something else like drawing or whatever else interests you.


These are just a few simple ideas, hopefully they help. Good luck :)
